# Templates

These templates are designed to make ProjectOps practical. They are deliberately lightweight, but structured enough to support governance, delivery, adoption, and benefits measurement.

## How to use these templates

- Copy the template into your preferred tool (Markdown, Confluence, SharePoint, Word, Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub Issues).
- Keep each artefact current. If it is not maintained, delete it or simplify it.
- Link templates together rather than duplicating content.

## Recommended minimum set

For a first implementation, use these five:

- Project Brief
- Decision Log
- RAID Log
- Release Readiness Checklist
- Benefits Register
